title: The guardrail's inline loop ignored the per-round cap and spent 6 h 12 m on one dataset
symptom: A single rice-leaf dataset processed all 30,000 images at 1.7 img/s; the chain then died because mega never ran.
root_cause: The synthesized autolabel call passed no max_images and fell to the function default of 30,000; the continuation flag was only written when mega evaluations existed.
correction_made: GUARD_PER_DS=8000 / GUARD_TOTAL=15000 in the guardrail; force-continue when autolabel is pending or mega_round_count==0.
